posts.cooked:
Hey folks, so after receiving my copy of Villains of the Multiverse I decided to bring out my (sadly) long-neglected SotM boxes and set up some games with friends over the weekend. While going through the boxes I realized I still have a couple of sets of the Dark Watch Promo cards sitting there untouched. I'd like to get these out to fans that are missing them but I was struggling to find a more or less equitable way to get them out there between just handing them out to the first person that claims them and putting them up for auction... and the best thing I could come up with was some sort of trade for other Sentinels awesomeness. I'm pretty open to any trade suggestions, but some things that I would definitely like to get are:

- RISE (Citizens of the Sun) and Baron Blade pins from the Foam Brains Sentinels Pin Collection (out of stock when I last tried to order them)

- Mr. Chomps plush replica (can never have too many mechanical raptors laying around).

- Some other fan-made cool piece of Sentinels-themed paraphernalia (that won't take up too much room).

So please feel free to message me or post here if you have some cool Sentinels stuff you'd like to trade for some Dark Watch promo cards.

Thanks!
